subject.title: Feature request: per-pattern session maintenance retention rules

question: Should OpenClaw add public ordered session-maintenance retention rules, and should matching be based on typed session metadata rather than raw session-key globs?
rationale: The request adds public config and destructive cleanup behavior, so automation should not choose the matcher contract or safety semantics without maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve typed retention rules
options.body: Add ordered first-match rules over stable typed criteria with global `pruneAfter` fallback and cleanup preview coverage.

options.title: Approve raw key globs
options.body: Expose the user-proposed key-pattern matcher, accepting that session-key internals become a more durable config contract.

options.title: Defer broad rules
options.body: Keep this open while resolving narrower preserveKeys, per-label retention, and retention-semantics issues first.

recommendation.title: Approve typed retention rules
recommendation.body: Add ordered first-match rules over stable typed criteria with global `pruneAfter` fallback and cleanup preview coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame on the active maintenance config and resolver surfaces points to this person as the best available routing owner.
